At some point after the [[Invasion of Begeren|conquest]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Begeren]] in [[3678 BBY]]<ref name="Shades" /> by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], a group of natives formed a '''terrorist cell''' that resisted the Imperial occupation. However, [[Lassicar]], a son of two of the cell's members, exposed the cell's existence to Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Harvus]] sometime before the end of the war in [[3653 BBY]], resulting in the [[Death/Legends|execution]] of the group's members.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The terrorist cell was briefly mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the in-game Codex entry for Guardsman Lassicar.<ref name="Codex" />
